A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TD/FQI/PFQI convergence framework. Their main text, equations, and complete appendices support comparison after matching extensively relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v2 reports mathematical convergence results and algebraic counterexamples, including Appendix G.3. It does not report original experiments, simulations, or empirical data analyses.

after.justification: v3 remains a theoretical paper, retaining the algebraic counterexamples and analytical batch-setting extensions. Empirical findings mentioned in the literature discussion are attributed to other work.

M1.justification: The TD, FQI, and PFQI updates, target-parameter mechanism, and preconditioning formulation are retained. Rewritten derivations and corrected convergence bounds do not introduce a different algorithm.

E1.justification: Neither version evaluates datasets or benchmarks. The expected, stochastic, batch, on-policy, off-policy, and over-parameterized settings are retained; their consolidation into appendices does not expand evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: No empirical comparator set is added or revised. TD, FQI, and PFQI remain the same objects of theoretical comparison; changed citations do not introduce evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Neither version reports experimental splits, metrics, training budgets, or testing procedures. The learning-rate bound correction changes a mathematical convergence condition, not a reported experimental setting.

E4.justification: No ablation, sensitivity experiment, or robustness study is added or removed. The constructed TD/FQI counterexamples in Appendix G.3 are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated runs, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable statistical uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: The matrices, numerical eigenvalues, and opposite TD/FQI convergence outcomes in Appendix G.3 are unchanged. No empirical result entries are added or revised; changes to mathematical statements are assessed under T1.

T1.justification: v3 corrects the TD learning-rate threshold from 2 Re(λ)/|λ| to 2 Re(λ)/|λ|² in Corollary 6.3 and Appendix E, replacing v2 Corollary 4 and its supporting statements. However, v3 Corollary D.6 changes the full-rank assumption from A_LSTD to A_FQI while retaining inverse-based expressions that the weaker assumption does not guarantee. These are localized revisions within the retained theoretical framework.

C1.justification: The central unification, convergence characterizations, and on-policy extension remain. v3's abstract adds explicit priority claims, particularly that this is the first introduction of matrix splitting into these algorithms' convergence analysis, strengthening the stated novelty without changing the research scope.

C2.justification: v3 Sections 4–5 more explicitly interpret FQI's relative robustness through nonsingularity of its own linear system under rank invariance, without feature independence. v2 emphasizes adaptive preconditioning and discusses nonsingularity of the target system. Most feature-dependent convergence explanations and batch-setting qualifications are retained.

D1.justification: The analytical update formulas and empirical-matrix definitions for batch data are retained, with the latter consolidated in Appendix K. Neither version supplies experimental implementation details, hardware information, or code/data access instructions.

R1.justification: v3 adds Chen, Clarke, and Maguluri's target-network/truncation work and removes citations including Yao and Liu's preconditioned TD and Ghiassian et al.'s regularized corrections. Appendix I also adds a qualification anticipating correction of Che et al.'s result following personal communication. The broader positioning is retained.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and main exposition are extensively rewritten and condensed. Related work is integrated into the introduction, while detailed preliminaries, interpretations, Z-matrix analysis, over-parameterization, and batch material are reorganized across appendices. v3 also introduces a duplicated explanatory paragraph in Section 5.

P2.justification: The manuscript is extensively reset in NeurIPS format, changing the title/author block, margins, text width, equation wrapping, and placement of mathematical displays throughout. Neither version contains experimental figures or result tables.

improvement.justification: v3 corrects the TD step-size bound and provides a more focused main narrative. However, Corollary D.6 weakens v2 Corollary 2's assumption while retaining inverses that may not exist, introducing a mathematical inconsistency. The duplicated Section 5 paragraph and misleading theorem-reference labels also reduce clarity. These countervailing accuracy and presentation changes prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
